skills.name: system_control_extension
skills.description: Extend control-panel controls with audio input/output selection, current-user services and media playback. First list/status to discover exact targets. Audio: list/status/set_default. User services: list/status/start/stop/restart. Media: list/status/play/pause/play_pause/stop/next/previous. Reports fresh evidence and whether the effect is verified; unavailable backends are explicit.

target.description: Exact discovered audio device ID/name, user .service unit, or media player name.
